messages:
Ivy: Quick triage — ran onboarding eval for new rerank-slim-3b int8 on two holdouts (holdout-mix-2026-06 and holdout-web-2026-06). Observed NDCG drop ~2.3 pts vs fp16 on holdout-web but only ~0.6 pts on holdout-mix. MRR shifts small but inconsistent.

Noah: interesting divergence. were both runs using the same candidate sampling and padding pipeline? sometimes different ingestion jobs produce subtle candidate order changes.

Ivy: same harness version. command for web holdout:
```
./eval_rerank.py --model rerank-slim-3b --weights quant/int8-new.ckpt --holdout holdout-web-2026-06 --seed 21 --batch 128 --report ndcg,mrr --dump-tops=100
```
and for mix holdout identical args swapping holdout. runtime flags: pack_kv=auto, per_channel=true, eval_mode=off

Hector: did you bootstrap? Could be sampling noise or dataset mismatch — web holdout has more HTML-noise docs which amplifies quant noise.

Ivy: ran a quick bootstrap 5k resamples: web p_value=0.02 for ndcg_all (int8 vs fp16), mix p_value=0.34. So web drop looks significant.

QA-Bot: preflight checks: candidate parity=OK, tokenizer parity=OK, padding parity=FAIL (2% of docs clipped for web holdout). See gist: https://gist.github.com/ivy/web-clip-diff

Noah: clipping again. pack_kv=auto is suspicious, especially on noisy web docs where padding/alignment heuristics may trigger. Try ablation: pack_kv=false and eval_mode=true to force deterministic input handling.

Ivy: kicking quick ablations: variant A (pack_off+eval_mode), variant B (per_tensor). ETA ~30m.

EvalBot: run-started: 6180101140 variant=pack_off_eval_mode

EvalBot: run-started: 6180101150 variant=per_tensor

Ivy: results: pack_off+eval_mode -> ndcg_web=0.658 (fp16_baseline=0.672) ndcg_mix=0.661 (fp16=0.667); per_tensor -> ndcg_web=0.651 ndcg_mix=0.659

Hector: pack_off+eval_mode recovered most of the gap. per_tensor helps but not fully. So runtime heuristics caused input mutation for web holdout and amplified quantization perturbations.

Noah: action items: 1) during onboarding runs, default to --eval-mode which disables pack/align heuristics, 2) add token-length/padding parity check in harness that fails the run if mismatch > 0.5%, 3) include bootstrap gate for ndcg with n>=5k in the onboarding checklist. I'll add a short blurb to the bringup doc.

Ivy: added RNW-2041 for parity gate and PR to harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-evals/pull/509

QA-Bot: note created: rerun full web holdout with locked pack_kv=false and per_tensor ablation and attach top-100 diffs and per-layer logit histograms.

Ivy: will rerun overnight and post artifacts. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
